name: Aelthalyste
summary: Aelthalyste is a banshee priest trainer and prominent figure among the Forsaken priesthood, stationed in the War Quarter of the Undercity. She oversees the spiritual discipline of Forsaken acolytes, teaching them to wield the dark energies of Shadow. She also coordinates with other Horde faith leaders, directing troll acolytes to their own elders in Orgrimmar.

sections.title: Voice of the Forgotten Shadow
sections.body: Unlike many priests across Azeroth who revere the Holy Light, Aelthalyste guides Forsaken priests who have turned from the Light toward the power of shadow. Rising as an incorporeal banshee, she embodies the spectral agony and relentless resolve of Sylvanas Windrunner's followers. From her chamber in the Undercity's War Quarter, she calls aspiring priests back from distant outposts to master the darker arts of their discipline, teaching them to harness suffering as a lethal weapon.

sections.title: Ties with the Horde
sections.body: While her focus remains firmly on her Forsaken flock, Aelthalyste maintains mutual respect with other Horde spiritual practitioners. Recognizing the distinct nature of Darkspear spiritualism, she directs troll initiates away from her own shadow doctrines and sends them across the sea to Ur'kyo in Orgrimmar. This gesture of deference ensures that Horde spellcasters develop within their cultural traditions while cementing alliances between Kalimdor and Lordaeron.

faq.answer: Aelthalyste is a banshee priest trainer residing in the War Quarter of the Undercity. She serves as a leading teacher of the Forsaken priesthood, instructing Forsaken practitioners in Shadow magic.
She is located in the War Quarter beneath the ruins of Capital City in the Undercity, surrounded by fellow Forsaken instructors.

Many Forsaken priests feel the Holy Light abandoned them in undeath. Rather than revering the Light as they did in life, they have turned toward shadow, embracing darkness, willpower, and personal discipline.

faq.q: Why does Aelthalyste send troll priests to Orgrimmar?
faq.answer: Aelthalyste recognizes that the troll relationship with the spirits and shadow differs greatly from Forsaken doctrine. As a sign of respect, she sends troll acolytes to train under Ur'kyo, the Darkspear priest trainer in the Valley of Spirits.
She provides core priest instruction to Forsaken characters and directs advanced acolytes into signature undead rituals, including spells like Touch of Weakness and Dark Sacrifice.
Yes. As a banshee within the Undercity, she serves Sylvanas Windrunner and works actively to strengthen the Forsaken through the mastery of dark magic.

angles.text: For Forsaken priests, Aelthalyste represents the core of their doctrine, granting specialized dark spells and guidance in the ways of shadow.
Aelthalyste reflects the Forsaken transition away from the Holy Light of their former lives toward the pragmatic power of the Shadow.
Rather than forcing troll initiates to adopt Forsaken rites, Aelthalyste directs Darkspear priests back to Ur'kyo in Orgrimmar out of mutual respect.
Her cooperation with Kalimdor trainers like Ur'kyo demonstrates how religious respect helps bridge cultural gaps across the young Horde coalition.
